headlines.reliable: Nothing worrying stood out on this page.
headlines.concerns: Mostly fine, but a few things are worth a closer look before you buy.
headlines.careful: Several warning signs: check the seller and reviews carefully before buying.
headlines.junk_or_scam: Strong signs of generic factory goods or a dishonest offer.

timer_resets.title: Fake countdown
timer_resets.detail: This countdown restarts when you reload the page: the deadline isn't real.

fake_urgency_app.title: Urgency tricks
fake_urgency_app.detail: The shop uses {app}, a tool for countdowns or 'someone just bought this' pop-ups that create pressure.

countdown.title: Countdown timer
countdown.detail: A countdown timer pushes you to decide quickly.

preticked_addon.title: Paid extra already ticked
preticked_addon.detail: A paid extra is ticked for you in advance ({label}). That's not allowed in the EU: untick it if you don't want it.

drip_pricing.title: Price goes up at checkout
drip_pricing.detail: At checkout the total is {pct} higher than the price on the page.

late_fees.title: Costs revealed later
late_fees.detail: Some costs (such as shipping or fees) only appear at checkout.

review_velocity.title: Suspicious number of reviews
review_velocity.detail: {count} ratings for a product that's only been listed for {age}.

review_shape.title: Unnatural rating pattern
review_shape.detail: Almost only 5-star and 1-star ratings, hardly anything in between: a pattern often seen with bought reviews.

duplicate_reviews.title: Copy-paste reviews
duplicate_reviews.detail: {pct} of the reviews repeat another review almost word for word.

off_topic_reviews.title: Reviews about something else
off_topic_reviews.detail: {pct} of the reviews don't seem to be about this product: they may have been carried over from another listing.

review_import_app.title: Imported reviews
review_import_app.detail: The shop uses a tool that copies reviews from other sites, such as AliExpress.

word_soup.title: Title full of search terms
word_soup.detail: The title is a string of search terms rather than a product name: typical of generic factory goods.

generic_brand.title: Unknown brand
generic_brand.detail: {brand} isn't a recognisable brand: usually a sign of generic factory goods sold under a made-up name.

generic_product.title: Generic product
generic_product.detail: This looks like a generic product that's also sold elsewhere under other names, often for less.

implausible_claims.title: Hard-to-believe claims
implausible_claims.detail: The page makes claims that are hard to believe for this product: {claim}.

pushy_copy.title: Pushy sales talk
pushy_copy.detail: The text uses pressure tactics, such as scarcity or 'today only' offers.

big_discount.title: Too-good discount
big_discount.detail: A {pct} discount on a 'was' price that may never have been charged.

was_never_charged.title: 'Was' price not charged recently
was_never_charged.detail: This product sold for {low} in the past 30 days, yet the 'was' price is {was}.

implausible_discount.title: Unbelievable discount
implausible_discount.detail: {pct} off: discounts this deep are almost always measured against a price nobody paid.

reference_anchor.title: Discount on a 'recommended' price
reference_anchor.detail: The 'was' price is labelled {anchor}: a reference price, not what this shop charged before.

permanent_sale.title: Never-ending sale
permanent_sale.detail: The page says {phrase}: shops that are always closing down use this to rush you.

seller_not_brand.title: Sold by another company
seller_not_brand.detail: Sold by {seller}, not by the brand itself.

ships_from_far.title: Ships from far away
ships_from_far.detail: Ships from {place}: expect long delivery times, and returns can be hard.

dropshipping_tools.title: Dropshipping
dropshipping_tools.detail: The shop uses dropshipping tools: products are shipped straight from a supplier.

supplier_links.title: Supplier traces
supplier_links.detail: The page contains links or images from wholesale sites such as AliExpress or Temu.

missing_trust_info.title: Little shop information
missing_trust_info.detail: No clear return policy, contact details or company information.

no_withdrawal.title: No return policy found
no_withdrawal.detail: No return or withdrawal policy found, though EU shops must offer one.

no_imprint.title: No company details
no_imprint.detail: No company name or address found on the page.

invalid_vat.title: Invalid VAT number
invalid_vat.detail: The VAT number shown isn't valid in the EU register.

new_domain.title: Brand-new web shop
new_domain.detail: This web shop's address was registered only {age} ago.

short_registration.title: Registered for a year
short_registration.detail: The shop's web address is only registered for one year.

hidden_ai_text.title: Hidden text to fool checks
hidden_ai_text.detail: The page hides text aimed at AI tools, to influence checks like this one.

ai_text.title: Text aimed at AI
ai_text.detail: The page contains text that addresses AI tools or rating systems.

overall.title: Several small signals
overall.detail: No single big problem, but several smaller signals together lowered the score.

vat_registered.title: Registered company
vat_registered.detail: The VAT number checks out in the EU register.

established_domain.title: Established shop
established_domain.detail: This web shop's address has existed for {years} years.

trust_info_present.title: Shop details present
trust_info_present.detail: Return policy and company details are on the page.

natural_reviews.title: Natural-looking reviews
natural_reviews.detail: Ratings are mixed and spread over time, as you'd expect from real buyers.

nothing_found.title: No warning signs
nothing_found.detail: Nothing suspicious found in the listing, the reviews or the page.

features.pricing.history_days: How long we've seen this price
features.listing.seller_not_brand: Sold by another company than the brand
features.shop_links.linked_shops: Other shops with the same accounts
features.shop_links.linked_young_shops: Young shops with the same accounts
features.shop_links.shared_payment: Payment account shared with other shops
features.shop_links.shared_contact: Contact details shared with other shops
